name: Warsong Supplies
summary: At Splintertree Post, Locke Okarr needs Warsong Supplies to keep the lumber camp working. Some wait in town, some in Booty Bay, and others lie in enemy hands across Ashenvale.

sections.title: Keeping the Saws Spinning
sections.body: From Splintertree Post, Locke Okarr works to keep the Warsong Lumber Camp supplied. The Warsong Clan needs a steady flow of heavy tools to harvest Ashenvale's ancient timber. Furbolg and satyr raids have scattered or seized local supplies, leaving the camp short of vital gear.

sections.title: A Scattered Logistics Chain
sections.body: You gather equipment from across Kalimdor and beyond. Pixel, the goblin courier at Splintertree Post, has circular saw blades. In Booty Bay, Wharfmaster Lozgil holds a crate of heavy axes. Foulweald and Thistlefur furbolgs have taken logging ropes, while satyrs at Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian stole barrels of Warsong machinery oil for their profane rites.

faq.q: What are the required Warsong Supplies?
faq.answer: Locke Okarr needs four items: Warsong Saw Blades held by Pixel, a crate of Warsong Axes awaiting in Booty Bay, Logging Rope taken by local furbolgs, and Warsong Oil stolen by Ashenvale's satyrs.
Locke Okarr is an orc at Splintertree Post who coordinates material deliveries to the Warsong Lumber Camp. He needs help recovering scattered shipments before the camp's work is delayed.

faq.q: Why is the Horde shipping equipment from Booty Bay?
faq.answer: The Horde uses neutral trade networks such as the Steamwheedle Cartel to import specialty goods that Durotar and the Barrens cannot easily forge in bulk. Goblin channels route heavy lumbering axes through maritime hubs such as Booty Bay on their way to Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why do the satyrs want Warsong Oil?
faq.answer: Satyrs at Satyrnaar, Night Run, and Xavian divert stolen industrial oil from machinery to corrupted rites dedicated to the Burning Legion and the spreading taint of Felwood.

faq.q: Which furbolgs stole the logging rope?
faq.answer: The Foulweald and Thistlefur furbolg tribes took the Logging Rope. Both are fiercely hostile to the Horde's clear-cutting across Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why is the Warsong Lumber Camp so vital to the Horde?
faq.answer: The Warsong Lumber Camp provides timber the Horde needs for construction and military supplies. Durotar's arid lands offer virtually no usable timber, so the Warsong Clan harvests Ashenvale's massive trees to build Orgrimmar and support the Horde's growing military infrastructure.

angles.text: The Horde's expansion into Durotar depends on lumber secured by the Warsong Clan. Recovering these tools helps support Orgrimmar.
As an orc, you help honor the Warsong Clan's legacy in Ashenvale by keeping its axes sharp and camps supplied, despite harassment from forest natives.
As an engineer, you can see how goblin supplies, from Pixel's saw blades to steam-engine lubricants, help keep the machinery working as the Warsong Clan cuts Ashenvale's ancient forests.
